units.title: Module 1
topics: Types of Dams and Foundation Treatment: Classification of Dams
Selection of Type of Dam, Merits and demerits of all types of dam, Importance of Subsurface Exploration

units.title: Module 2
topics: Forces acting on the Dam, Combinations of load on the Dam, Causes of failure of Dams
Elementary and Practical Profile of a Gravity Dam, High and Low Dam, Stability Analysis of a Gravity Dam, Design of Gravity Dams
Construction of dam, and joints in Dams

units.title: Module 3
topics: Causes of failure of Earth dams
Profile of an Earth Dam, Side slopes and Protection Measures for Earth Dams
Core and Casing for Earth Dams
Cut off and Seepage Control Measures in Earth Dams
